_plane_z_comment: Height (m, world frame) of the workspace plane that the pixel->3D homography projects onto. Used as the Z coordinate of every detected key.
plane_z_2_comment: Second plane height if key was not pressed successfully on the first try.
_image_resolution_comment: [width, height] in pixels of the camera image the VLM key coordinates are expressed in. Used to scale the normalized (0-1000) VLM pixel coords back to real image pixels before applying the homography.
_finger_tip_pose_facing_down_comment: 4x4 homogeneous transform specifying the finger tip pose. The 3x3 rotation block forces the finger tip to always face directly downwards (gripper z-axis points along world -z). The translation column is overwritten per-target with (x, y, z), so its values here are placeholders.
_hover_comment: Hover waypoints used around each key press. The robot moves to pre_press above the key, descends to the key, then retreats to post_press. Offsets are in meters in the world frame; y_mult is a multiplicative scale applied to the target's y coordinate (used to bias the approach/retreat to the side).
_num_keypoints_comment: Number of waypoints in the quintic-spline trajectory between two end-effector poses. Higher = smoother and slower motion; lower = faster but coarser. Applied to every pre-hover / press / post-hover segment.
_auto_stop_comment: Early-termination of the descent-onto-key motion based on detecting that the finger tip has touched the keyboard (z-coordinate stops changing). enabled: turn the check on/off. z_diff_threshold: per-step |Δz| (m) below which a step counts as 'stalled'. consecutive_stalled_steps: how many consecutive stalled steps must occur to stop. start_fraction: fraction of the trajectory that must elapse before the check is allowed to trigger (0.5 = second half).
